issues.reason: Official current archive exposes 2025–2026 only; comparative figures extend selected financial rows to 2024. Older 10+ year history remains uncollected, not estimated.
PPE purchases are not labelled total cash CAPEX. Construction-finance repayments are a separate cash outflow; no complete FCF inferred from incomplete investment detail.
Actual parent profit is kept apart from total comprehensive income attributable to owners. Quarterly and cumulative periods are separate.
Adjusted EBITDA includes the company-defined proportionate JV effect; no unqualified EBITDA margin calculated against consolidated sales.
Statement publication dates unconfirmed; dated press release separately recorded. No LTM or daily multiples.
